text:
claire_sales: Heads-up — BrightLane wants a 2-week hosted promo for their POC. Asking for tiered per-token pricing: gen $0.00045/token for first 25M tokens/week, $0.00035 thereafter; embeds $0.00009 flat. They asked to waive the $500 min for the POC. Need sign-off today. cc @ryan_dealmgr @tom_finance

ryan_dealmgr: Got it. Do they want a contract amendment or just a temporary promo code? Also need projected tokens.

claire_sales: They prefer a short addendum. Projected usage: week1 20M gen, week2 40M gen, embeds 8M/week. No long-term commit.

tom_finance: Quick calc: with tiering, week1 cost = 20M * 0.00045 = $9k. Week2 cost = (25M*0.00045) + (15M*0.00035) = 11.25k + 5.25k = 16.5k. Embeds 2 weeks = 16M * 0.00009 = $1.44k. Total ~ $26.94k. If we waive min_charge, ok but finance wants a bill cap and GL mapping. Also need revenue recognition note: classify as one-time promo credit if we apply coupon.

nina_salesops: We can create a "poc-temp-tiered" plan and enforce weekly tiering via billing rules. Two enforcement options: (A) hard token cap per week + promo rates; (B) prepaid credit that covers estimated spend and reverts to list after. Which does Sales prefer?

claire_sales: Option A preferred — keep visibility in console with rates showing. Customer prefers predictability and tracking.

infra_bot: FYI infra can enforce weekly caps and tier boundaries by attaching a billing policy to the account. Need account id and promo id. No infra changes needed.

ryan_dealmgr: I'm okay to greenlight if Finance signs off and Legal approves POC addendum. Also require a clause: Redwood reserves right to throttle to protect SLOs if usage spikes.

tom_finance: Approve contingent on: (1) a $35k cap for the 2-week POC (covers expected + 30% buffer), (2) promo labeled as one-time billing override, (3) salesops attach GL code 4001-API-TRIAL. If Sales agrees, I will sign off.

claire_sales: I'll ask BrightLane to accept the $35k cap and the addendum now. If they push back, offer a $30k prepaid credit instead.

nina_salesops: Draft promo object (internal):
```
plan_id: poc-temp-tiered-brightlane
duration_days: 14
weekly_tiers:
  - tier1_limit: 25000000
    gen_rate: 0.00045
  - tier2_rate: 0.00035
embed_rate: 0.00009
min_charge_override: 0
total_cap: 35000
billing_label: one-time-poc-override
GL_code: 4001-API-TRIAL
```

legal_bot: Reminder: POC addendum needs data handling clause + liability cap. If customer is enterprise, include SOC/Audit note.

claire_sales: Copy — I'll get addendum signed and confirm account id. Planning to send now.

infra_bot: Once we have account id + promo id, we'll attach enforcement and watch metrics. Alerting: we'll fire a support rms if consumption hits 80% of cap.

ryan_dealmgr: Leaving final approval pending signed addendum and finance email ok. :thumbsup:

claire_sales: thanks team — pinging here once signed. :pray:
